name: Azure Dictation
description: Stream microphone speech to Azure Speech and insert transcripts into dashboard drafts. Independent community plugin; no voice-note ingestion or TTS.

apiKey.description: Azure Speech resource key; otherwise reuse Azure TTS settings or the Speech key environment variables.

region.description: Azure Speech resource region, for example eastus.

language.description: Recognition locale, for example en-US. Otherwise reuse Azure TTS lang, then en-US.
